photos.c: Right: Regular scorer in the Women's Southern League, Gail Richardson prepares to launch the 600gm spear in match 3 but it was in the hammer and discus that she picked up wins.
To see Gail Richardson hurdling at Wimbledon Park you wouldn't have thought that she normally throws javelin and shot - and started off as a walker!
Gail Richardson started off her athletics as a walker but is now mostly to be seen in the throwing events where she's not too far behind Pet Keeler's Hammer Record.
